name: Darkonika - Kub Dushi
source:
The main character Alan Traur, a mercenary. He was tasked to find a girl kidnapped by local vampire gang, but he decided to join "fangers". His new mission from vampires - find the Soul Cube, creepy artifact that can extract souls from people.
Player must lead the character through series of events, including fight with indulge, race through the foggy woods against the wolves, prophetic dreams, meeting with the God of Death and solving a seventy-year-old mystery.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/490940/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角艾伦·特劳尔是一名雇佣兵。他的任务是寻找一名被当地吸血鬼团伙绑架的女孩，但他决定加入“Fangers”。他来自吸血鬼的新任务 - 找到灵魂立方体，这是一种可以从人们身上提取灵魂的令人毛骨悚然的神器。
玩家必须带领角色经历一系列事件，包括纵情战斗、穿越迷雾森林与狼群赛跑、预言性的梦境、与死神会面以及解开七十年之久的谜团。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/490940/]Steam[/url]]
